description: Reckless lane diagnostic complete: Bullet input clamp fix prevents Enyo32 first-step clipping.

metadata.result: checkpoint 0-8 have input_weights 0, input_biases 0, L1 0, L2 0; only four output weights differ from reference by <=1.49e-8 from Bullet float roundtrip already at checkpoint0
metadata.prior_bug: Before the fix, trainable Enyo l0 weights/biases were optimizer-clamped to +/-4095, corrupting existing-weight checkpoints whose int16 accumulator tensors contain larger legal values.
metadata.decision: keep the full-int16 l0 clamp fix; discard previous Enyo32 input-only gate results that were based on clipped checkpoints; lr=2e-7 is below exported sparse movement after the fix.
